Infrared Sauna Benefits and Safety

Infrared saunas have been studied mainly in small, short trials, often in people with heart failure, chronic pain or fatigue, with generally positive results and few side effects. The large long-term studies linking saunas to lower heart disease and dementia risk used traditional Finnish saunas, not infrared.
